dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The blades aren't exactly the same as the ones in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Yeah, the materials and methods used to forge the weapons aren't the same, so the resulting weapons would be of a different style as well.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: I heard that Liyue's Archon, Rex Lapis, was skilled at the forging of weapons. Previously, I was curious about what the blades made in Liyue were like.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: So a while ago, I requested someone from the Crux Fleet to bring a weapon made in Liyue to me. I learned a lot after studying that weapon.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Now, I have fully grasped the techniques that were used to forge that weapon. Seeing as you have deep connections with Liyue, I'll gift this weapon to you.
